name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter Kovács's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate mechanics of engines. From a young age, she spent hours dismantling and reassembling anything she could get her hands on, a passion that ultimately led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local racing team before joining Ipiranga Racing five years ago.

Eszter's approach to race engineering is characterized by her pragmatic and data-driven mindset. She believes in meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car's performance to identify areas for improvement. Her ability to translate complex technical data into actionable strategies has earned her the respect of her colleagues and the drivers she works with. Her dedication to constant learning and improvement makes her a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Eszter apart is her unwavering focus on reliability and consistency. She understands that winning races requires not only speed but also a machine that can withstand the rigors of competition. Her keen eye for detail and proactive approach to problem-solving ensure that the car is always performing at its best, lap after lap.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eszter is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing practical, functional clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on double-checking every measurement, no matter how small.
